method_notes: Sweep of Equinix, Digital Realty, AirTrunk, Vantage, STACK, NTT, STT GDC, Keppel, CapitaLand, DayOne/GDS, ESR, PDG, Colt, True IDC/True Corp, AIS/CSC, CAT/NT, TCC Technology, CS Loxinfo, Empyrion, Digital Edge, EdgeConneX, Microsoft, Google, AWS, Meta, Apple, Bridge Data Centres, SUPERNAP, Evolution, GSA (Gulf/Singtel/AIS).

Places swept: Bangkok districts (Bang Na, Hua Mak, Pathumwan/Ratchada), Nonthaburi, Pathum Thani, Samut Prakan (Phraeksa, Bang Phli hints), Chonburi/EEC, Rayong, Chachoengsao, Amata City Chonburi, WHA Chonburi IE2, Khlong Tamru.

Allowed SoR only: company IR/press/SET/official DC; Gulf SET PDF; ADB; Google Data Centers locations; BOI mentions on company pages. Forbidden SoR (Baxtel, DataCenterMap, AIDCI, DC Byte, Wikipedia, consultant averages, news-only recaps) used as hints then verified or rejected.

Grain kept: IT capacity ≠ facility/service/power capacity ≠ interconnection/grid ≠ generation/PPA. Equinix Bangna IBX held (cabinet grain). Sub-250 disclosed pins stay (GSA01 25.6, STT 46/2, Empyrion 20, NTT 1.6, Evolution TH01 52, etc.).
Dry-run only. Do NOT publish to compute.world or GitHub. Fetch cache: /workspace/state/campus-hunt/thailand-fetch/.
